cases.title: Preserve idempotency during billing webhook retries
cases.goal: A retry must not create a second charge. Before implementation, verify the current idempotency rule against the latest incident analysis.
cases.requirement_original:
# Billing retries
A duplicate event must reuse the original charge receipt.
cases.requirement_changed:
# Billing retries
A duplicate event must reuse the original charge receipt and retain the external event ID.
cases.supporting_original:
# Incident
One retry occurred during provider recovery. No duplicate charge confirmed.
cases.supporting_changed:
# Incident
A second retry was discovered after the provider callback timed out. No duplicate charge confirmed.

cases.title: Restore accessible checkout failure message
cases.goal: 결제 실패 안내를 화면 읽기 도구가 읽을 수 있게 수정한다. 실제 오류 조건이 바뀌면 이전 인수인계 지시를 재검토한다.
cases.requirement_original:
# Checkout failure
Announce the failed payment to screen readers without exposing card details.
cases.requirement_changed:
# Checkout failure
Announce the failed payment and retry instructions without exposing card details.
cases.supporting_original:
# Session
Keyboard users reached the payment error after a retry.
cases.supporting_changed:
# Session
Screen-reader users reported the retry hint was skipped after the second attempt.
